addressed.change: Changed variance_percent quantization rounding from ROUND_HALF_EVEN to ROUND_HALF_UP
Fixed money decimal places validation to check exponent < -2 instead of numeric equality, so '1.000' correctly raises ValueError

claims.title: variance_percent uses ROUND_HALF_EVEN instead of ROUND_HALF_UP
accepts more than 2 decimal places when trailing zeros hide numeric equality
